judgment.notes: M002 is instantiated with X=Eucl(k), d=a and s=A; D001 supplies the metric and Borel structures. Its nonempty-member cost agrees with D003 at every finite positive scale because a>0, including diameter zero; empty members cost zero. M003 and M004 use the same space and set and the nonnegative-real representative of a>0. Their strict dimension inequalities are precisely L1 and L2, respectively, and their conclusions are converted by F001. The supplied signatures impose no set-measurability condition. Routine background conditions are verified in the notes.

S001 compares identical finite-scale cover costs and correctly discards the additional infinite scale: its infimum is no larger than any finite-scale infimum. S002 applies the two critical-exponent premises; S003 obtains the converse bounds by contradiction and nonnegativity from D005. In S004 cover inclusion gives content and measure inequalities, and a finite positive intermediate exponent contradicts any strict reversal of dimensions, including an infinite larger dimension. In S005 image covers after intersection with A and inverse-image covers after intersection with g(A) preserve coverage and do not increase diameters; distance preservation supplies injectivity and equality of pairwise distances. The resulting two content inequalities imply equality at every scale and hence equality of suprema, without any exchange of limits. F003 and the same intermediate-exponent argument give equality of dimensions. Empty sets have zero positive-exponent contents, so F003 bounds their dimension by every positive real and nonnegativity makes it zero. Every N001 clause follows.

All imported results used are direct inputs M002–M004. F001 precedes F002; both precede F003, which is legitimately generalized over arbitrary k,A and the positive exponent with no open extra premise. S004 and S005 can therefore instantiate F003 for B and g(A), including a different ambient dimension. L1–L4 are discharged into their stated implications. The intermediate exponent has an elementary explicit choice (BG003); cover families and their images/preimages are scoped constructions. No future fact, unexported producer property, new H or escaped witness is used.

Replaying the conditional implication uses only the three supplied input statements, D001–D005, the displayed local derivation and the positively assessed routine background below. Normalization, critical-exponent consequences, monotonicity and isometry invariance are actually derived in the packet. No other R body, source-paper proof or absent project lemma is needed. This judges mathematical sufficiency, not carrier identity.

D001–D005 specify the Euclidean/Borel spaces, extended diameter, countable diameter-cost contents, native measure and dimension convention needed by all statements. M002–M004 state their complete applicable conditions. N001 explicitly quantifies Euclidean dimensions, arbitrary subsets and positive exponents, retains A⊆B and distance preservation as conditional premises, and exports all proved consequences. The consequences involving H remain under a>0, its defined domain. The l-dimensional image is a subset of Eucl(l); no measurability, extension of g to the ambient space or nonemptiness assumption is required.
